subject: Fairy tales
hook: FAIRY TALES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Fairy tales are surprisingly old, with research suggesting they may date back thousands of years to the Bronze Age.
angle_support: according to researchers at universities in Durham and Lisbon, such stories may date back thousands of years, some to the Bronze Age.
Many of today's fairy tales have evolved from centuries-old stories that have appeared, with variations, in multiple cultures around the world.
title: Fairy Tales Are Ancient
description: While many associate fairy tales with Renaissance writers or the Grimm brothers, new research suggests these stories have much older roots. Mathematical models indicate these tales trace back to the Bronze Age.
narration: FAIRY TALES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture these stories as charming inventions from the era of kings and queens. It was closer to a prehistoric survival mechanism spanning far further back than that. Research from universities in Durham and Lisbon suggests these narratives are far older than the seventeenth century. Mathematical modeling indicates many core stories likely originated during the Bronze Age, thousands of years before they were ever written. The magic you recognize has been echoing for thousands of years.
